run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest D in an array where D equals A plus B plus C
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify it returns the correct largest D value
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses four nested loops to find D equals A plus B plus C in an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the O(n to the fourth) brute force approach with a more efficient algorithm
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array then searches for the largest element expressible as a sum of three others
